anvil:aws:HttpApi.description: An Anvil-managed AWS HTTP API Gateway (API Gateway v2). Route-level consumers support Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions, and HTTP proxy integrations. Secure by default: TLS 1.2 minimum enforced on custom domains, execute-api endpoint disabled when a custom domain is set, conservative throttling defaults (1000 rps / 500 burst), CORS opt-in with wildcard origin blocked, per-consumer least-privilege IAM roles, access logs on by default.

defaultAuthorizerId.description: The API Gateway authorizer ID to apply to all routes. Pass auth.authorizerId from an OAuthAuthorizer or CognitoAuth component. All routes inherit this authorizer unless skipAuth: true is set on the route. Omit to leave all routes public.

routes.description: The API routes. Each route maps a method and path to a consumer. At least one route is required.

domain.description: Optional custom domain for the API. When set, Anvil provisions the ACM certificate, API Gateway domain name, and Route 53 DNS record automatically. The raw execute-api endpoint is disabled — all traffic must flow through the custom domain.

cors.description: Optional CORS configuration. Opt-in — omit to disable CORS entirely. When enabled, allowOrigins is required and wildcard '*' is blocked as a security measure.

throttling.description: Optional throttling configuration. Defaults to rateLimit: 1000 rps and burstLimit: 500 concurrent requests when omitted. Without throttling a single route can exhaust the account-level limit shared across all APIs.

logRetention.description: CloudWatch access log retention period. Presets: '7d' | '30d' | '90d' | '1y' | '3y' | '6y' | '7y'. Default: '1y' — satisfies SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS baseline retention requirements.

apiId.description: The API Gateway HTTP API ID.

apiEndpoint.description: The default execute-api endpoint URL. Empty string when a custom domain is set and the execute-api endpoint is disabled.

url.description: The primary URL for the API. When a custom domain is configured this is the custom domain URL. Otherwise it is the execute-api endpoint URL.

certValidationCname.description: ACM cert validation CNAME. Only populated when domain.dns: false and domain.certificateArn is omitted. Add this record in Cloudflare (or your DNS provider) then re-run deploy — Anvil blocks until ACM confirms validation.

anvil:aws:HttpApiCertValidationCname.description: ACM certificate DNS validation CNAME record. Only populated when domain.dns: false and domain.certificateArn is omitted. Add this record in your DNS provider (e.g. Cloudflare) then re-run deploy — Anvil blocks until ACM confirms validation.

name.description: The CNAME record name to add in your DNS provider.

value.description: The CNAME record value to point to.

anvil:aws:HttpApiRoute.description: A single route on the HTTP API mapping a method and path to a consumer target.

skipAuth.description: Explicitly opt this route out of the API-level defaultAuthorizer. Use for health checks, webhook endpoints, or any route that handles its own validation. Has no effect if defaultAuthorizerId is not set.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes required to access this route. API Gateway rejects tokens that do not contain all listed scopes. Only applies when defaultAuthorizerId is set and skipAuth is false. Example: ['read:users', 'write:orders'].

method.description: The HTTP method for this route.

path.description: The route path. e.g. '/users' or '/users/{id}'. Use {param} for path parameters and {proxy+} for greedy paths.

consumer.description: The target that handles this route. Exactly one consumer type must be set.

throttling.description: Optional per-route throttling override. Inherits API-level throttling when omitted.

anvil:aws:HttpApiRouteConsumer.description: The target that handles a route. Exactly one field must be set — Anvil validates this at deploy time and returns a clear error if zero or multiple are set.

lambda.description: Route to a Lambda function. Pass lambda.arn directly.

sqs.description: Route directly to an SQS queue. No Lambda required. Returns 202 Accepted immediately — message is processed asynchronously. Must use POST, PUT, or PATCH.

eventBridge.description: Route directly to an EventBridge bus. No Lambda required. Must use POST, PUT, or PATCH.

stepFunctions.description: Route to a Step Functions state machine. Async by default. Must use POST, PUT, or PATCH.

http.description: Proxy to an external HTTP URL. Useful for gradual migration from legacy APIs.

anvil:aws:HttpApiLambdaConsumer.description: Routes requests to a Lambda function via AWS_PROXY integration. API Gateway invokes the Lambda synchronously and returns its response directly.

arn.description: The Lambda function ARN. Pass lambda.arn directly. Accepts Output<string>.

anvil:aws:HttpApiSqsConsumer.description: Routes requests directly to an SQS queue. API Gateway sends the request body as a message — no Lambda required. Returns 202 Accepted immediately. Anvil creates a least-privilege IAM role granting sqs:SendMessage on this queue only.

url.description: The SQS queue URL. Pass queue.url directly. Accepts Output<string>.

arn.description: The SQS queue ARN. Pass queue.arn directly. Accepts Output<string>.

anvil:aws:HttpApiEventBridgeConsumer.description: Routes requests directly to an EventBridge bus. API Gateway puts the request body as an event — no Lambda required. Anvil creates a least-privilege IAM role granting events:PutEvents on this bus only.

name.description: The EventBridge bus name. Pass bus.name directly. Accepts Output<string>.

anvil:aws:HttpApiStepFunctionsConsumer.description: Routes requests to a Step Functions state machine. Async by default (StartExecution). Set sync: true for StartSyncExecution — note the 29s API Gateway timeout applies. Anvil creates a least-privilege IAM role granting the appropriate Start action on this state machine only.

arn.description: The state machine ARN. Pass stateMachine.arn directly. Accepts Output<string>.

sync.description: Wait for execution to complete before responding. Default: false (async). Only use for fast state machines — subject to the 29s API Gateway timeout.

anvil:aws:HttpApiHttpConsumer.description: Proxies requests to an external HTTP URL. Useful for gradual migration from legacy APIs or third-party integrations. No IAM configuration required.

url.description: The external HTTP URL to proxy to. e.g. 'https://legacy-api.mycompany.com'.

anvil:aws:HttpApiThrottling.description: Rate and burst throttling limits. Applied at the API level by default — individual routes can override. Defaults: rateLimit 1000 rps, burstLimit 500 concurrent. Without throttling a single route can exhaust the account-level limit (10,000 rps) shared across all APIs in the account.

rateLimit.description: Maximum sustained requests per second. Default: 1000.

burstLimit.description: Maximum concurrent requests (token bucket capacity). Default: 500.

anvil:aws:HttpApiCors.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing configuration. Opt-in — omit to disable CORS. Security rules: allowOrigins '*' is blocked, allowCredentials requires explicit origins, allowMethods is inferred from routes when omitted.

allowOrigins.description: Allowed origins. Required when CORS is enabled. Wildcard '*' is blocked — specify explicit origins. e.g. ['https://app.mysite.com'].

allowMethods.description: Allowed HTTP methods. Default: inferred automatically from the routes declared on this API.

allowCredentials.description: Allow cookies and auth headers in cross-origin requests. Default: false. When true, allowOrigins must not contain '*' — browsers reject this combination per the CORS specification.

maxAge.description: Preflight cache duration in seconds. Default: 86400 (24 hours) — reduces preflight requests significantly.

anvil:aws:HttpApiDomain.description: Custom domain configuration. When set, Anvil provisions the ACM certificate (with DNS validation), API Gateway domain name resource, and Route 53 A alias record. TLS 1.2 minimum is always enforced. The execute-api endpoint is disabled when a domain is set. Set dns: false for Cloudflare or other non-Route 53 providers.

name.description: The fully qualified domain name. e.g. 'api.mysite.com'.

basePath.description: Optional API mapping base path. e.g. 'v1' makes the API accessible at https://name/v1. Omit for root path mapping.

certificateArn.description: BYO ACM certificate ARN. When omitted Anvil creates and validates the certificate automatically via DNS validation. Required when dns: false to skip Route 53 cert validation entirely.

zoneId.description: Route 53 hosted zone ID. When omitted Anvil discovers the zone by domain name automatically. Ignored when dns: false.

dns.description: Create Route 53 DNS and cert validation records automatically. Default: true. Set to false for Cloudflare or other non-Route 53 DNS providers — Anvil will output the API Gateway target domain and (when certificateArn is omitted) the ACM validation CNAME for manual configuration.

anvil:aws:HttpApiMethod.description: HTTP method for an API route.

enum.description: HTTP POST — create operations and async consumers (SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions).
Matches all HTTP methods. Maps to the $default route key.
